about_the_game:
This demo is a sneak peek of On-Together, and is meant to showcase its diverse functionalities. The full game will have many more features, pets, customisation elements, and activities to enjoy with your friends :)

On-Together is a cozy productivity chatroom game that sits at the bottom of your screen while you focus on your tasks and socialize at break-time!

Stay connected while you study in a shared co-working chatroom space. Join conversations effortlessly, just like in a real study lounge—whether you're working solo or with friends. Perfect for study streams or quiet collaboration.

Use your personal built-in focus timer, to-do list, calendar, and journal to track tasks, set goals, and reflect on progress, keeping you focused and motivated. Stay focused long enough and a super cute customizable pet buddy will join you :)

On-Together lets you hang out, play multiplayer games, personalize your avatar, and more! Enjoy fun activities at your own pace, adding freedom to your workflow.

Progress over time by staying on task, discovering new features, or engaging with the community. Unlock new customization options along the way!

Whether you’re working, studying, or just fartin’ around, On-Together will help keep you company throughout the day.

… Oh, and did we mention we have multiple screen display options?

Your cozy study companions, always on your screen—whether fullscreen or neatly at the
bottom or top. Designed to make productivity feel both social and personal!

Features:

  • Work together! Join your friends in the digital lounge for some cozy co-working.

  • Share together! Play in fullscreen or keep the screen neatly to the side!

  • Track together! Keep on track with timers, calendars, checklists and more.

  • Play together! Take regular breaks and do fun activities with your friends.

  • On Together! Discover new features, customize your avatar, and stay engaged.
